description: Design a trust-winning LoopThing brand system using explicit Refero-style design rules future agents can follow.

userStories.title: Create brand strategy
userStories.description: As a founder, I need a brand plan that explains how LoopThing wins trust and avoids looking like a vibe-coded AI dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Explain brand promise, trust signals, visual stance, tone, and anti-patterns

userStories.title: Create DESIGN.md
userStories.description: As an agent building LoopThing UI, I need concrete colors, typography, spacing, components, and no-go rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Include palette, type, layout, components, motion, screenshots, and anti-patterns
Make the brand feel editorial, exact, and trustworthy

userStories.title: Build visual reference board
userStories.description: As a founder, I need 5-8 visual references and why each applies to LoopThing.
acceptanceCriteria: Save references and notes under design artifacts
Extract concrete style rules rather than vague mood words
userStories.notes: Created VISUAL_REFERENCE_BOARD.md with the extraction method and reference directions. Still open until concrete Refero screenshots/references are collected.
